description_en: Retrieves a list of data lake table names
description_zh: 调用此API可获取数据湖表名列表
kebab_example: aliyun dms list-data-lake-table-name --catalog-name hive --db-name default --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataLakeTableName

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.

Hover over your profile picture in the upper-right corner of the DMS console to obtain the tenant ID. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The name of the data catalog
parameters.name: catalog_name

parameters.help_en: The regular expression used to match table names
parameters.help_zh: 数据表名称匹配正则表达式
parameters.name: table_name_pattern

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken that is returned from the last call. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first call.

If NextToken is empty, no subsequent query is required.

If NextToken has a return value, the value is the token for the next query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The type of the table. Valid values:

MANAGED_TABLE: Internal table.

EXTERNAL_TABLE: Foreign table.

VIRTUAL_VIEW: Virtual view.

INDEX_TABLE: Index table.

MATERIALIZED_VIEW: Materialized view
parameters.help_zh:
数据表的类型，取值如下：

MANAGED_TABLE：内部表。

EXTERNAL_TABLE：外部表。

VIRTUAL_VIEW：虚拟视图。

INDEX_TABLE：索引表。

MATERIALIZED_VIEW：物化视图
parameters.name: table_type

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request fails
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码，请求异常时返回

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

NextToken.description_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, used for log tracing and troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：

true：请求成功。                                 
false：请求失败
